method: Spain: native 300 dpi JBIG2 images extracted with pdfimages, SECCION I-I and Mediciones cropped/upscaled and read visually. Hungary: 500-600 dpi renders read visually for callouts; vector CAD paths parsed from pdftocairo -svg for undimensioned arcs/chamfers (circle fits); implemented outlines agree with the vector vertices within 0.01-0.25 mm.

IV.reading_note: Top width callout '1,00' is faint in the scan; confirmed by the area and molde checks.

FPT-70/50.title_original: Az FPT70/50 jelű hídgerenda keresztmetszete (Az EHGE 70 hídgerendákkal készült felszerkezet esetén szélső tartó cseréjénél ajánlott)

ITG-45.reason: Template non-web chain 54.8 cm exceeds 45 cm depth; geometry for the 45 cm unit is not drawn.

conventions_and_estimates: Straight-line doble T outline exactly as drawn in SECCION I-I: no fillets or chamfers are drawn or dimensioned.

Vertical chain (top to soffit): top flange edge, top splay, web, bottom splay, bottom flange edge; each chain closes exactly to the printed canto total and matches the chain on the SEMIALZADO LONGITUDINAL elevation.
Only the central (midspan) section is modelled. End blocks (ensanchamiento/blochet) at the supports and the riostra are excluded.

Validation: gross area vs 'Mediciones - Sección central - Hormigón' m3/m (= m2 of section) within 3-decimal rounding for all six types (max 0.045%). Independent second check: 'Molde' m2/m equals the outline perimeter minus the top face within 2-decimal rounding.
No published centroid or inertia exists in the source; yb and I are analytic only.
FP: Plain polygon, every vertex dimensioned: 47 flat soffit, 1.5 x 1.5 bottom chamfers to 50 overall, 4.5 vertical edge, 3.5 wide side ledge rising 0.5 to the 43 wide upper body.
FP: The 13/15 cm closed stirrups projecting above the top (helyszíni betonnal együttdolgozás) are reinforcement, not concrete, and are excluded.
FP: No mass or section property is printed; validation is analytic only.

FPT: Printed: top 70 = 6 + 58 + 6, web 30 (bottom chain 20 + 30 + 20), flange chain from top 4 + 0.5 + 10.5 + 3.5, web length 'változó' (variable), overall depth chain '45;70;80;90;100;130'. Drawing is FPT-70 at 1:15.

FPT: Measured from the vector CAD outline (not printed): top-face slope reaches the ledge root at half-width 30.0 cm at 4.0 cm below top (1.0 horizontal over 4.0); ledge-root fillet R1, ledge-tip fillet R1, lower flange outer corner R2.5, web-flange fillet R2.5, bottom arrises 2 x 2 chamfers.
FPT: Only the web length varies with depth (explicit 'változó'). Mass step of 75 kg/m per 10 cm equals 30 x 10 cm x 2500 kg/m3.
FPT: Check: FPT-70...130 gross areas x 2500 kg/m3 reproduce the tabulated Súly within 0.02%. Nothing was fitted to the masses.

FPT: FPT-45 is PINNED: the same template gives 492.3 kg/m vs tabulated 455 kg/m (+8.2%); the 45 cm unit evidently differs from the drawn template in some undrawn way. Implemented as a template estimate.

FPT: FPT-70/50: separate fully dimensioned sharp outline (50 top, 16.75 + 1.75 + 51.5, web 30, no fillets or chamfers in the vector drawing). Area gives 613.1 kg/m vs 620 tabulated (-1.1%); PINNED, cause unknown (rounding, reinforcement or undrawn detail).
ITG: Tartóközép (midspan) section only; the Tartóvég (support) section with the full-width web is excluded.

ITG: ITG-90 fully chained: top 0.6 + 5.7 + 1 + 46.6 + 1 + 5.7 + 0.6 = 61.2; vertical 4.5 + 9.8 + 2.8 + 11.1 + 35.2 + 8.6 + 18 = 90; web 16 (12.4 + 10.2 + 16 + 10.2 + 12.4); bottom 12.4 + 0.7 + 35 + 0.7 + 12.4. Polygonal outline, no arcs in the vector drawing. Vector coordinates agree with the chain to <=0.03 cm.

ITG: Top: 46.6 top face slopes outward 1.0 over 4.5 to a horizontal ledge 5.7 wide, then a battered side (0.6 over 9.8) to the 61.2 overall width, underside 2.8 fall to 36.4 width, 11.1 haunch to the 16 web. Bottom: 36.4 widest at 18 cm, battered 0.7 to the 35 soffit, 8.6 splay to the web.
ITG: ITG-70 and ITG-110 are ESTIMATES: only the 90 depth is drawn; the depth callout '(45);70;90;110' is on the overall dimension. Assumed only the 35.2 web segment changes (15.2 / 55.2).
ITG: ITG-45 is NOT implemented: the fixed non-web chain totals 54.8 cm > 45 cm, so the drawn template cannot produce a 45 cm unit (it is also bracketed '(45)'). No defensible outline.
ITG: No mass or property table is printed.

FI-150: Printed: top 80 = 4 + 71 + 4 with 0.5 top-edge slopes (0.5 + 4 + 71/2 = 40 half width); web 14.6 (32.7 + 14.6 + 32.7 = 80; 22.7 + 14.6 + 22.7 = 60); bottom 60 = 1.5 + 57 + 1.5; vertical from soffit 4 + 12 + 23 + 93 + 8 + 7.5 + 0.5 + 2 = 150. The 20 cm projecting stirrup is reinforcement.

FI-150: Fillet radii are NOT printed. Radii taken from circle fits to the vector CAD arcs: ledge root R1, ledge tip R1, top-flange lower tip R2.5, web/top-flange R7.5, web/bottom-bulb R15, bulb upper corner R2.5 (fit residuals <=0.001 cm). Tangent points reproduce the vector vertices within 0.01 cm.
FI-150: Bottom arrises: 1.5 horizontal x 4 vertical chamfers (dimensioned).
FI-150: No mass or property table is printed; validation is analytic only.

pinned_discrepancies.issue: Template area x 2500 kg/m3 = 492.3 kg/m vs tabulated 455 kg/m (+8.2%)
Sharp fully-dimensioned outline gives 613.1 kg/m vs 620 kg/m (-1.1%)

not_implemented.reason: Drawn template's fixed non-web chain (54.8 cm) exceeds 45 cm; 45 is bracketed '(45)' in the depth callout. No defensible outline.

corrections_to_assessment: FPT-70 mass check: assessment reported +1.8%; the CAD-exact outline (with ledge root at 30.0 half-width, R1/R1/R2.5/R2.5 arcs and 2x2 chamfers) gives -0.02%.
HP-1 Type I published hormigon is 0.445 m3/m (confirmed at native resolution).
FI-150 and FPT radii are drawn in the vector CAD even though not printed; they were measured rather than guessed.
remaining_uncertainties: HP-1 legal status after 1977 (reported annulment 1985) not audited.
ITG-70/110 assume only the 35.2 cm web segment changes.
Ferrobeton sheets carry no revision date in the drawing; the ITG file name suggests 07/2015 (unverified).
Mass-based FPT check depends on the assumed 2500 kg/m3 density.
